description: Unsafe deserialization using pickle from untrusted input
diff:
diff --git a/api/session.py b/api/session.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/api/session.py
+++ b/api/session.py
@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+import pickle
+import base64
+
+def load_session(cookie_value: str):
+    """Load session from cookie — WARNING: uses pickle."""
+    try:
+        data = base64.b64decode(cookie_value)
+        return pickle.loads(data)  # UNSAFE: arbitrary code execution risk
+    except Exception:
+        return {}
+
+def save_session(session_data: dict) -> str:
+    """Serialize session to cookie string."""
+    return base64.b64encode(pickle.dumps(session_data)).decode()
